answer: Rewards vest. Nothing unlocks before 30 days of continuous uptime, and a single gap resets the clock. Review is staked, so the panel has skin in the verdict. Dry consequence, an operator that buys 200 seats has to keep 200 processes alive for a month before the first token moves, and any restart in that window costs the whole month. A garden of clones needs a gardener on shift at 3am. The ember of a farm burns out on an uptime check long before it reaches the nectar.
